crossRefs.note: He said to Moses, “Come up to Yahweh, you, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel; and…

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Nadab
people.line: Son of Aaron, consumed by fire for offering incense.

translations.web: Then Moses, Aaron, Nadab, Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel went up.

translations.kjv: Then went up Moses, and Aaron, Nadab, and Abihu, and seventy of the elders of Israel:
